headlines.description: — Brandon Marsh, Alec Bohm and Kyle Schwarber homered, Jesús Luzardo pitched seven strong innings and the Philadelphia Phillies defeated the Miami Marlins 8-2 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Marsh, Bohm and Schwarber homer as Phillies beat Marlins 8-2 behind Luzardo

events.name: Kansas City Royals at Washington Nationals

headlines.description: — Curtis Mead hit a tiebreaking three-run homer in the bottom of the seventh inning to lift the Washington Nationals to a 6-4 win over the Kansas City Royals on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mead's 3-run HR, Nuñez's big night lift the Nationals to a 6-4 victory over the Royals

events.name: Toronto Blue Jays at Boston Red Sox

headlines.description: — Davis Schneider and Andrés Giménez hit back-to-back home runs, Dylan Cease pitched five shutout innings and the Toronto Blue Jays beat the Boston Red Sox 6-1 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Blue Jays back Cease with 3 homers in 6-1 victory over Red Sox at Fenway

events.name: Chicago White Sox at New York Yankees

headlines.description: — Spencer Jones hit his first Yankee Stadium home run in the second inning, Ben Rice and Paul Goldschmidt each added a two-run drive in the fourth, and the New York Yankees rocked Davis Martin in a 12-2 victory over the Chicago White Sox on Tuesday...
headlines.shortLinkText: Jones, Rice and Goldschmidt homer off Martin in Yankees' 12-2 rout of White Sox

events.name: New York Mets at Cincinnati Reds

headlines.description: — Sal Stewart hit a three-run homer and Spencer Steer added a solo shot during a four-run first inning as the Cincinnati Reds defeated the New York Mets 5-3 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Sal Stewart's 3-run homer in 4-run first inning spoils Kodai Senga's return as Reds beat Mets 5-3

events.name: San Francisco Giants at Atlanta Braves

headlines.description: — Garrett Mitchell hit a solo homer in the seventh inning to lift the Milwaukee Brewers to a 2-1 victory over the Cleveland Guardians on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mitchell, Turang hit homers to pace Milwaukee past Cleveland 2-1

events.name: San Diego Padres at St. Louis Cardinals

headlines.description: — Andre Pallante threw seven strong innings, Blaze Jordan hit an RBI double and Nathan Church added an RBI single as the St. Louis Cardinals beat the San Diego Padres 3-2 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Pallante throws 7 strong innings as Cardinals beat Padres 3-2

headlines.description: — Willi Castro continued his hot streak with two RBI and TJ Rumfield hit a two-run home run as the Colorado Rockies evened their series against the Chicago Cubs with a 5-2 win Tuesday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Willi Castro and TJ Rumfield each drive in two runs as the Rockies beat the Cubs, 5-2

headlines.description: — Raynel Delgado drove in two runs in the eighth inning in his second major league game to help lift the Houston Astros to a 4-2 win over the Detroit Tigers on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Raynel Delgado drives in 2 in the eighth as the Astros beat the Tigers 4-2

events.name: Los Angeles Angels at Arizona Diamondbacks

headlines.description: — Mike Trout hit a two-run home run and an RBI double for the Los Angeles Angels in a 7-0 shutout of the Arizona Diamondbacks on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mike Trout homers as Angels shut out Diamondbacks 7-0

headlines.description: — Cal Raleigh hit a two-run single in his return from the injured list, Logan Gilbert struck out a season-high 10 in seven strong innings and...
headlines.shortLinkText: Cal Raleigh delivers decisive hit in return from injured list as Mariners top Orioles 3-1

headlines.description: — Brandon Lowe hit a tiebreaking homer in the ninth inning, Bryan Reynolds went deep from both sides of the plate and the Pittsburgh Pirates rallied from an early four-run deficit to beat the Athletics 6-5 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Lowe hits go-ahead homer, Reynolds connects twice as Pirates rally past Athletics for 6-5 victory

events.name: Tampa Bay Rays at Los Angeles Dodgers

headlines.description: — Shohei Ohtani hit his 15th home run of the season and Justin Wrobleski threw six innings to lead the Los Angeles Dodgers to a 1-0 win over the Tampa Bay Rays.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ohtani hits 15th homer as Dodgers beat Rays 1-0
